title: SCA Tish'a BeAb 2022: Mrs. Miriam Tawil

chapters.title: Introduction to Tish'a BeAb and the sense of loss
The historical destruction of the first temple
Laws and customs of the three weeks
chapters.about: minimizing happiness,mourning practices,inversion of personal mourning

chapters.title: The obligation to call out to Hashem
Rashi's explanation of the Bet HaMikdash as collateral
Rabbi Jonathan Sachs and the future tense of Judaism
chapters.about: Rabbi Jonathan Sachs,Future Tense,birth of history,hope

summary: Mrs. Tawil explores the meaning of Tish'a BeAb by looking at historical destructions and the laws of mourning during the three weeks. She discusses the concept of the Bet HaMikdash as collateral and examines insights from Rabbi Jonathan Sachs on the unique future-oriented nature of Judaism and its mission to the world.
questions: How can we mourn a loss that we never personally experienced?
What are the laws and customs observed during the three weeks leading up to Tish'a BeAb?
In what way does Rashi explain the destruction of the Bet HaMikdash as collateral?
What does Rabbi Jonathan Sachs teach about the uniqueness of Jewish history and the future?
